conditions.notes: Presented with bloody nasal discharge, pulmonary infiltrates, and mild renal involvement. Biopsy confirmed granulomatous inflammation. PR3-ANCA strongly positive. Treated with rituximab induction, then transitioned to azathioprine maintenance.
Sensorineural, likely vasculitis-related. Audiometry stable over past year.

family_history: No family history of autoimmune disease

social_history.compliance_notes: Patient has missed 3 of last 8 scheduled rheumatology infusion/follow-up appointments. Physician notes from 2025-11 mention 'discussed importance of treatment adherence, patient reports scheduling conflicts with work deadlines.'
